sources.content: The sorrelgate-proxy image runs Sorrelgate, a small TCP and HTTP reverse proxy. It is built on alpine:3.20 and runs as the non-root user sorrel with user ID 1500. HTTP traffic enters on port 8080 and the admin API listens on port 9901. The entrypoint is /usr/bin/sorrelgate with the argument --config /etc/sorrelgate/proxy.yaml. Mount a volume at /var/cache/sorrelgate to keep TLS session tickets across restarts. The image is about 24 MB compressed.

Environment variables. SORREL_LOG_LEVEL sets log detail and defaults to info. SORREL_WORKERS sets the number of worker threads and defaults to 4. SORREL_UPSTREAM gives the default backend address and has no default; the container exits with code 2 when it is missing. The health check runs sorrelgate check every 20 seconds with a 3 second timeout and marks the container unhealthy after 5 failed checks. Logs go to standard output in JSON format.
